verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://help.cakeequity.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the Help Centre. Help articles are served as .md URLs, including agent-focused docs on connecting an AI assistant, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: llms.txt evidenced only on the help subdomain (not the main site), no llms-full.txt or agent-specific API reference (OpenAPI paths all 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
